title: Terra'sQoL
description: Quality of life for administrators. Still early development, so don't be too harsh.
body: This is a datapack dedicated to assisting administrators on realms, otherwise I might as well tell you to go look at the Essentials-X plugin. Since realms are quite limiting as to how much you can moderate, I would like to assist with that and make it easier. If you have any comments, questions, or concerns, you can message me on discord at: Fission Reaction#4585. Thank you.
